text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Recently, rumors have been swirling about a nuisance paparazzi lurking around the academy grounds.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lately, of all things, they've even slipped inside the campus.
A notice has gone out asking anyone who spots them to alert security, but no one has managed to catch a trace of them.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
And so—Shakur!
Team up with me!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? Hell no.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...We can't just let that paparazzi run wild. One of my friends already got harassed by 'em.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: To catch someone so slippery, I need your brains. Join the Paparazzi Buster Squad!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Like I give a crap. Who the hell would bother playing along with your little—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: SIR, YES, SIR! Member No. 1 of the Paparazzi Buster Squad, Agnes Digital, reporting for duty, sir!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —...You've gotta be kidding me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: A paparazzi of all scoundrels...! Precious moments of horse girls are meant to be received with deep reverence and humble grati-tuuuude!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Taking sneaky photos like that is just... tactless! Despicable! Utterly missing the point! Mere otaku though I may be, I absolutely cannot stand by and watch this!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
So, you in, Shakur?
Don't tell me your blood ain't boiling hot with rage too.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Not in the slightest.
Go do whatever the hell you—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
............ Tch. Actually...
...Hold on a sec.

text_block_list.name: Paparazzi
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, looks like I'm gonna get another goldmine photo...! Don't mind if I—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—Heh. Licking your chops right in front of your prey, huh?
Now that's a villain face straight out of the movies.

text_block_list.name: Paparazzi
text_block_list.text: Wh-What the!? Dammit...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Contact made at predicted intercept Point D.
Zero hesitation in his retreat.
Bastard had an escape route mapped out in advance.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hah... A thoroughly logical route, huh?
—Which means you're an open book, dumbass.

text_block_list.name: Paparazzi
text_block_list.text:
Shit...! H-How the hell does she know where I'm headed!?
...Tch, in that case!

text_block_list.name: Paparazzi
text_block_list.text: *pant* *pant*... Once I blend into the crowd, there's no way they can follow me...! I'll just hop on the train and—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Haha! Now this is a stage worth dancing on!

text_block_list.name: Paparazzi
text_block_list.text:
!? Wh-Whaaaat!? Weaving right through the crowd—
What is with those dance-like steps!?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Hey. Game of tag over already?

text_block_list.name: Paparazzi
text_block_list.text: Ghk, a-alright, I get it! I'll never take paparazzi shots again, I swear... just let me off the hook...!

text_block_list.name: Paparazzi
text_block_list.text: (Damn it... Even so, I gotta protect the sneaky shots on this memory card no matter what—)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: —Hmph. You there... You're hiding photos and recorded data of horse girls on your person, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Paparazzi
text_block_list.text: !? H-How did you know that...!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
—Their aura, of course.
Inanimate object or not, it contains the precious essence of horse girls within...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Game over, Mr. Paparazzi...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so—thanks to the combined efforts of the three,
the pesky paparazzi was brought to justice without further fuss.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...A chase through the downtown streets.
Ended up getting some pretty decent data out of it.
choice_data_list: Looks like a legendary trio is born!
I hope you three keep guarding the peace of the horse girls.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...A chase through the downtown streets.
Ended up getting some pretty decent data out of it.
choice_data_list: Looks like a legendary trio is born!
I hope you three keep guarding the peace of the horse girls.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hah? Not a chance.
This was a one-time deal.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: E-Exactly! Being grouped together with these two illustrious figures is far too presumptuous for a humble fan like meee~~!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Come on, don't be so cold!
Let's stick together, the three of us!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —It didn't take long for the trio to make a name for themselves across the academy as the "Jack-of-All-Trades Trio."

text_block_list.name: Tap & Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Aye-aye! You got it!"
"Aye-aye! Of course!!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —Sigh. Do whatever the hell you want.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Though despite saying that, I had a feeling Air Shakur would end up getting dragged along anyway.
